responsibility: This tree definition file introduces the extra GCC tree codes used only by the D frontend. It declares the custom nodes for logical unsigned right shift, floating-point modulus, and function-frame/closure metadata, allowing the generic tree machinery and generated switch tables to recognize D-specific IR nodes that are later lowered by D gimplification and code generation code.
same_name_distinction: This is the narrow tree-code definition file in the d-tree pair: it only adds D-specific DEFTREECODE entries such as UNSIGNED_RSHIFT_EXPR and FUNCFRAME_INFO, whereas d-tree.h is the broad internal header that defines flags, data structures, enums, and cross-file lowering interfaces built around those nodes.
